design_notes: Use hairline rules and two rule weights; serif throughout; single accent colour (e.g. deep blue) for table headers and pull-quote rule.
Tables should be full-width with right-aligned numeric columns; pull-quote set in larger serif with a left rule.
No decorative imagery; keep the layout clean and newspaper-like.

sidebars.body_markdown: A B Infrabuild proposes a public issue of 44,28,000 equity shares of face value ₹10 each. The issue price is not yet fixed (shown as ₹[●] in the DRHP). [^drhp-p29] The stated object is to meet working capital requirements of ₹1,130 lakh (₹11.3 crore) plus general corporate purposes, the amount for which is not disclosed. [^drhp-p48] The lead manager is Mark Corporate Advisors Private Limited; the registrar is Bigshare Services Private Limited. [^drhp-p31] The DRHP does not explicitly show an offer-for-sale component; every clue points to a fresh issue, but the split is not spelled out in the provided facts. [^drhp-p29]
sidebars.rationale: A sidebar condenses the offer's key terms (size, price, object, managers) into a scannable reference, complementing the prose.
sidebars.title: The offer at a glance
